data.exact_reserve_text: During the year there was a positive net run-off contribution of GBP 36,411,000 (2013 GBP 45,805,000), of which the main contributors were third party liability, GBP 9,020,000 and marine, aviation and transport GBP 3,590,000 (2013 marine, aviation and transport GBP 7,492,000 and other damage to property GBP 10,507,000). There was a positive development on reinsurance acceptances of GBP 26,795,000 (2013 GBP 25,109,000).
